content_sections.heading: GNLU Deputy Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: maximum 55 years. Eligibility is determined on the last date of receipt of the application. Mandatory qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Mandatory experience: applicants must be officers in the Central/State Government, Universities or other autonomous Organisations who meet one of these conditions: Holding an analogous position on regular basis in Pay Level 12 Five years of regular service in Pay Level 11 Eight years of regular service in Pay Level 10 Desirable: Experience in dealing with General Administration, Establishment Personnel and HR related affairs or Procurements Experience in dealing with N-Procure and GeM Stores, computer-based Finance and Accounts, Audit or Academics Knowledge of UGC Rules and Regulations and DoPT Rules Who is not eligible: Anyone convicted by a Court of Law at any time during their career Persons dismissed by, or involved in disciplinary cases with, the Union Government, a State Government, a Local Authority or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by the Central or State Government Employees of a Government Organisation or PSU with a Vigilance, Disciplinary or Criminal case pending or contemplated against them Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The University shortlists candidates and then holds an interview. After the last date, it informs eligible shortlisted candidates through the email address given in the application form. The list of eligible candidates will also be uploaded on the GNLU official website. Original certificates must be produced at the time of the selection process. Employed candidates called for selection must produce a No Objection certificate in the prescribed format given in the application form. Without it, they will not be allowed to appear. No shortlisted candidate will be considered after the prescribed date and time, whatever the reason. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of posting: GNLU Silvassa Campus, Dadra & Nagar Haveli-396230. The selected candidate may also be deputed to the Gandhinagar campus as and when required. Tenure: three years initially. This may be extended year to year on need and performance, with due approval of the Competent Authority, up to a maximum of five years. No extension follows after that. Performance: reviewed annually. Services shall be terminated in case of unsatisfactory performance. No claim to a permanent post: the appointment gives no right to renewal, extension or conversion into permanent appointment, and it ends on expiry of tenure. Joining: the selected candidate must join on the date the University specifies. The University may decline to appoint a candidate who cannot join by then. Verification: antecedents may be verified at any time during recruitment or service. If the information is found incorrect, the application or service shall be terminated without notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GNLU Deputy Registrar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed format and affix a recent passport size photograph. Incomplete applications and those in any other format will not be accepted. Attach the documents listed below. Submit the application through proper channel. You may send an advance copy directly to the University. Write this on the envelope: "Application for the position of Deputy Registrar (On Deputation basis) at GNLU-Silvassa Campus". Send it by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier to: The Registrar, Gujarat National Law University, Attalika Avenue, Knowledge Corridor, Koba, Gandhinagar, Gujarat-382426, India. Applications or resumes sent by email will not be considered, and neither will applications that arrive late because of postal delay or any other reason. Documents to send: Self-attested copies of certificates and mark-sheets from SSC onwards Vigilance clearance Attested copy of the last five years' ACR/APARs Do not send original certificates with the application.

faq.question: Q1. Can a Pay Level 10 officer apply for the GNLU Deputy Registrar post?
faq.answer: Yes, if the officer has eight years of regular service in Pay Level 10. Officers in Pay Level 11 need five years of regular service.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the selected Deputy Registrar work?
faq.answer: The posting is at the Silvassa Campus in Dadra & Nagar Haveli. The candidate may be deputed to the Gandhinagar headquarters as and when required.

faq.question: Q3. How long can the deputation last?
faq.answer: The term is three years at first and can run to a maximum of five years, following the 03+01+01 pattern in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. Does the post include HRA and DA?
faq.answer: Yes. The position carries the full scale with benefits including HRA, TA and DA as per University norms.

faq.question: Q5. Can the application be sent by email?
faq.answer: No. It must go by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier to the Registrar at the Koba, Gandhinagar address.

faq.question: Q6. Is the post reserved for any category?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the advertised position is un-reserved as per the norms.

faq.question: Q7. Which service records must employed candidates send?
faq.answer: They must send vigilance clearance and an attested copy of the last five years' ACR/APARs, through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Will the University pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid for attending or participating in the selection process.
